name: The Chase Park Plaza Royal Sonesta St. Louis
insider_take: This grand 1922 landmark isn't just a hotel—it's St. Louis royalty with a cinema, rooftop tennis, and enough old-world glamour to make Gatsby jealous.
whats_special: The Chase Park Plaza is home to the historic Chase Park Plaza Cinema, one of the last remaining Art Deco movie theaters in America. The hotel also features a stunning rooftop tennis court that's been serving aces since the Jazz Age, and its Khorassan Ballroom boasts hand-painted Persian-inspired murals that took artisans over two years to complete.
pro_tip: Book the penthouse level for exclusive access to the rooftop terrace—it offers unparalleled views of Forest Park, which is actually larger than New York's Central Park and hosted the 1904 World's Fair.
dont_miss: Catch a classic film at the in-house cinema, explore the underground tunnels that once connected to the adjacent buildings during Prohibition, and stroll through nearby Forest Park to see the Saint Louis Art Museum and the iconic Gateway Arch just minutes away.
pros: Historic luxury hotel with timeless elegance and classic architecture
Prime Central West End location near Forest Park and cultural attractions
Multiple dining venues including rooftop restaurant with city views
Full-service spa and comprehensive fitness facilities
Extensive event spaces and ballrooms for weddings and conferences
cons: Historic building may show age in some areas
